dsh-cve-audit is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Live CVE/supply-chain audit for your workspace's own project dependencies (npm/pip/go), backed by OSV.dev, with a `cve_audit` tool plus optional automatic re-scan on lockfile changes.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-7ee4ab81db1cb2ffd8d2.html
